finalMessage:
Implemented shipping: free when the discounted subtotal is at least 100.00; otherwise 5.99, included in the total and payment.

Tests cover threshold boundaries and discounts. `go test ./...` and `ostf check --base main` pass.

Trace impact: `R-CHECKOUT-ORDER`, `R-CHECKOUT-SESSION`, and new draft `R-CHECKOUT-SHIPPING`. Tests: `TestPlaceOrder`, `TestPlaceOrderNeedsSession`, `TestPlaceOrderShipping`.

Added shipping links to `N-BUY`, `Checkout.PlaceOrder`, `Quote`, and `TestPlaceOrderShipping`. All links revalidated and stamped.
